normalized_evidence.page_title: Planning for emergencies in the capital
normalized_evidence.publisher: Greater London Authority / London City Hall
observed_facts: The page publishes London's generic emergency plans and coordination protocols.
It lists the Strategic Coordination Protocol, Tactical Coordination Protocol, LESLP Operational Coordination Principles, and London Recovery Coordination Framework.
The source window publishes no Polygon or MultiPolygon and no new exact source-area identifier.
